sections.title: Part 1. Incomplete Sentences
sections.instruction: Choose the word that best completes each sentence.

items.passage: The delivery was late, so the manager decided to ____ the meeting until the parts arrived.
items.explanation: 부품이 올 때까지(until)라는 말이 회의를 없애지 않고 미룬다는 단서다.

items.passage: Visitors must ____ their bags at the front desk because large items are not allowed inside.
items.explanation: 큰 물건은 안으로 가져갈 수 없으므로 안내 데스크에 맡겨 둔다.

items.group_instruction: Questions 3–4 refer to the following notice.
items.passage: To all staff: The second-floor printer will be (3) ____ this Friday while a technician checks it. Please use the machine on the first floor instead. If you need many copies, (4) ____ your request to the office team by Thursday noon.
items.explanation: 기술자가 점검하는 동안 다른 층의 기계를 쓰라고 했으므로 쓸 수 없다는 뜻이다.

items.passage: To all staff: The second-floor printer will be (3) ____ this Friday while a technician checks it. Please use the machine on the first floor instead. If you need many copies, (4) ____ your request to the office team by Thursday noon.
items.explanation: 목요일 정오까지 사무팀에 요청을 보내라는 안내다.

items.stem: Match each word on the left with its closest synonym on the right. Two options will not be used.
